note_en: 快要……了 and 就要……了 mean something is about to happen: 秋天快要到的时候 "as autumn approaches," 看起来就要成熟了 "looks as if it will soon be ripe." English uses "about to" or "soon," but Chinese wraps the verb: 快要 or 就要 before it and 了 at the end of the sentence. Note that inside a 的时候 clause, as in the first example, the final 了 is dropped.
